name: Spell
aiContext: A spelling app. It starts on a screen with a Start button. Each word is spoken aloud with a sentence; the screen shows the sentence with a blank, a text box, Check and Hear again. A right answer shows Right. A wrong one shows 'Not quite. You wrote …' with the struck-out attempt and the correct word in large letters, its tricky letters underlined, and the student types it while looking; the word is asked again from memory a few words later. A new word is first shown in large letters to copy, then asked from memory later. The end screen says Finished and how many words were right first time.
